_readme: Enter values from your own copy of each source. Leave null to skip. Do not paste tables into the repo: the entry cites document, edition and table/example only.

psychrolib._limits_note: Limits are half a unit of the last digit printed in the example; adjust to the digits your copy prints.

pyfluids.source: IAPWS R6-95(2018), table of single-phase verification values (free at iapws.org)
pyfluids._note: One object per (T, rho) row. Fill only the columns the table prints: p_MPa, cv_kJ_kgK, cp_kJ_kgK, w_m_s, s_kJ_kgK.
